title.ja: GBMのweak誤差とMonte Carlo標準誤差
title.en: GBM weak bias and Monte Carlo error

summary.ja: 連続真値、離散EM期待値、同一経路差とMCSEを分離する固定入力です。
summary.en: Separate continuous truth,exact discrete EM expectation,paired-path weak difference and MCSE.

assumptions.ja: dX=.5Xdt+.4XdW,X0=1。無次元T=1、8/16/32/64刻み、独立32seed×1024経路。状態軸に境界・clipなし。

algorithm.ja: fine Gaussian増分を固定block和で集約し、厳密端点1配列を全刻みで共有。OUの厳密積分はdWとの共分散を保つ独立bridge正規変数から構成。異なる加算順の和のbit一致は主張しません。
algorithm.en: Aggregate fixed fine Gaussian blocks;reuse one exact terminal array. OUexact kicks use the correct jointly sampled integral with independent bridge noise. Different floating reduction orders need not be bit identical.

validation.ja: 軌道前にDecimal80/120・独立GH/OU共分散積分とpaired分散による標本解像を資格。各モーメントの5MCSE校正、MCSE精度、固定3段weak率、最後2段の3SE解像を判定。区間の被覆は離散真値に対する有限32反復の記述値。
validation.en: Before paths qualify Decimal80/120,independent GH/OUcovariance integrals and paired-variance allocation. Gate5MCSE calibration,MCSE precision,fixed three-level weak rate and final-two-level3SE resolution. Coverage is descriptive over32batches against discrete truth.

limits.ja: 弱誤差は期待値の差です。3SEや区間を真の誤差上界・一般被覆保証としません。1D状態×時間の保存例であり2D物理流れではありません。GBMやOU浴成分を新しい物理問題として重複計数しません。
limits.en: Weak error is a difference of expectations. SE/intervals are not true-error bounds or general coverage guarantees. State×time examples are not2Dphysical flow. Existing GBM/OUbath physical families are reused.

review_level.ja: 一次資料選択確認＋著者導出の有限モーメントを独立資格
review_level.en: Selected primary text plus independently qualified authored finite-moment identities

references.author: D. J. Higham
references.title: An Algorithmic Introduction to Numerical Simulation of Stochastic Differential Equations

review.ja: 原著の線形SDE厳密解、strong/weak定義、EM、Milstein補正の選択節を確認。論文全体やMATLAB実験の再現ではありません。掲載strong定義L1と本例L2 RMSを区別します。
review.en: Read selected original sections4-6 on linear SDEs,strong/weak definitions,EM and Milstein. No full-paper audit or reproduction of its MATLAB/logistic experiment. Its L1strong definition is distinguished from our L2RMS.

caption.ja: 保存した実データ由来の分布・誤差診断。空間次元と標本/時間軸を区別します。
caption.en: Distribution and error diagnostics from actual saved data;sample/time axes are distinguished from spatial dimensions.

title.ja: 同じBrownian経路のMilstein・EM strong比較
title.en: Milstein and EM on identical Brownian paths

summary.ja: 補償項を持つMilsteinとEMの終端L2 RMSを、厳密端点と有限モーメントから検査。
summary.en: Compare compensated Milstein and EM endpoint L2RMS against exact endpoints and finite-moment identities.

algorithm.ja: Milsteinは.5σ²X(dW²-h)を追加。全法・刻みでfine driverと厳密端点1配列を共有。負状態を修復しません。
algorithm.en: Milstein adds.5sigma²X(dW²-h). All methods/levels share the fine driver and one exact terminal array. No state repair.

validation.ja: 相殺を含む解析MSEをDecimal80/120と独立1step GHで資格。二乗誤差の5SE校正、固定3段RMS率、最細段の優位性を判定。相関を保つ64pathblock jackknifeで率の不確実性を記述。
validation.en: Qualify cancellation-prone analytic MSE by Decimal80/120and independent one-step GH. Gate squared-error5SE calibration,fixed-three-level RMS rates and finest advantage.64paired path-block jackknife describes slope uncertainty.

limits.ja: L2終端誤差を扱い、原著のL1定義と区別。GBM以外の非Lipschitz系・正値性の一般保証はしません。既存gbm-sdeへの手法追加です。
limits.en: EndpointL2error is distinct from the selected paper L1definition. No general non-Lipschitz/positivity guarantee. This extends existinggbm-sde rather than adding a physical problem.

review_level.ja: 一次Milstein補正選択確認・独立精度資格
review_level.en: Selected primary Milstein correction and independent precision qualification
